name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 121 – Am 43
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 121d. Recalls that according to Oxfam, 31 of the EU’s wealthiest individuals each emit 3 469 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent per year through the use of their superyachts and jets alone; recalls that this figure is 432 times more than the emissions of the average European; calls on the Commission to make a new proposal to introduce a luxury carbon tax on luxury goods, including yachts, private jets and sports utility vehicles, as a new own resource; recalls that such a tax would be socially just and help mitigate climate change, and could be more effective than a classic carbon tax;
